Maya (AE): LargeBank wants a 4-week technical trial. Key constraints: VPC+KMS, retention 30d, acceptance: automated quality >= 92% on 120 labeled prompts, p95 latency <= 200ms in-region, cost goal <= $0.32/1k tokens. Can we draft a practical acceptance playbook and rough burn estimate before kickoff?

Evan (Sales-Eng): I can run the eval harness. Need exact prompt breakdown (summaries/extractions/classify) and concurrency profile. Also need reference outputs for the labeled set.

Priya (Solutions): For latency target recommend redwood-rt-13b-quant, kv_cache=on, batch_size=6, max_seq=512. We'll enable prefix cache for repeated system prompts. If p95 misses, prepare trimmed model variant or lower batch.

Noah (SRE): Token math: assume avg 280 tokens/request, target 12 RPS sustained -> 280*12=3360 tokens/s ~12.1M tokens/hr. For a 4-week pilot with focused testing (approx 200 peak-hours) plan ~2.4B tokens would be extreme; propose baseline burn = 200M tokens for acceptance runs. That maps to cost at $0.32/1k = ~$64k gross. Suggest offering $25k pilot credit and capping exposure.

Asha (Product): Proposed gates: 1) Automated eval (120 prompts) pass >=92% 2) p95 <=200ms under their 90th-percentile concurrency 3) No critical PII leakage on 20 adversarial cases 4) Final manual spot-check (10 samples) 5) Billable usage <= agreed cap.

Evan (Sales-Eng): Eval harness snippet I'll use to capture latency and outputs:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rt-13b-quant","prompt":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":220,"temperature":0.0}' | jq -r '. | {output: .output, latency_ms: .meta.latency_ms}'
```
We'll store results and run the scoring job against their labeled set.

Priya (Solutions): Also enable response_dedupe during automated runs to avoid repeated token burn, and enable no-store + retention=30d. For VPC we need customer CIDR + KMS key ARN.

Noah (SRE): Once we have CIDR and KMS ARN provisioning ETA is 4 business days for a Dedicated VPC endpoint. I'll open infra ticket now.

Maya (AE): Timeline suggestion: Week 0 - collect prompts & refs; Week 1 - baseline runs & canary; Week 2 - tuning; Week 3 - load/soak and adversarial tests; Week 4 - acceptance + handoff. Deliverables: eval harness (Evan) by Thu EOD, infra ticket (Noah) created, canary config (Priya).

Evan (Sales-Eng): Uploading harness + scoring notebook to their GH repo and will share runbook tomorrow.

Maya (AE): Great — posting action items here. Update thread when tasks complete :thumbsup:
